title: City of New York Municipal Airports
coreRelationships: Two airplanes, one above the other, dominate the upper two-thirds of the composition.
The red sky provides a strong, uniform background for the aircraft.
The lower third of the image is dedicated to text, separated by a wavy line representing water.
The airplanes are rendered in a simplified, graphic style with minimal detail.
The text block is horizontally structured with clear hierarchical information.
reuseFormula: Recreate the composition with two stylized aircraft (one flying, one landing/taking off from water) against a solid, vibrant background. Below a wavy line, place a large, bold text block with hierarchical information. Maintain a limited, high-contrast color palette and a graphic, simplified aesthetic reminiscent of vintage travel posters.
